title: OpsTruss _meta
description: The first object of every stack: the version of its layout, the project it belongs to, and the data key of the stack, in an age envelope, a sops envelope, or both. Readers ignore fields they do not know.

key.description: The data key, wrapped for the encryption_keys of the stack when it was wrapped.

age.description: The data key encrypted with age, ASCII-armored, for the age recipients in to.

sops.description: The data key as the sops program encrypted it, for the keys in to.
